contract.operation: Remove any subset leaving a nonempty ordered survivor list while changing the survivor ACI color. Exact full-tuple subsequence retains the established route; otherwise each survivor must uniquely match exactly one original on every non-ACI modeled field, in order.
contract.sourceAndAtomicity: Original and live raw tuples and ASCII spellings must agree; conflicting raw edits, ambiguous anchors, invalid changed ACI, changed offsets or linetype references, consumed or missing ordinary consumers, missing providers and late changes refuse atomically. Corrected same-adapter retry is tested.
contract.bounds: Exact matching checks ACI before anchor strings and precharges both linear passes; fallback precharges the source-element/string-byte cross-product. The private production helper has exact and one-below limit, long-string, accumulated, zero-pass and overflow controls.
contract.typedCopyLimit: The pre-existing typed/model copy and its string traversal are accounted by retained-byte limits; the comparison-work precharge is not a total CPU, RSS, allocator or concurrency bound.
contract.limits: No claim of edit history or general identity; 1→0 edits remain refused after the peer audit. Offset/linetype edits composed with removal, consumed geometry, other versions and unknown/proxy dependencies require separate proof. Native rendering and whole-document support remain unqualified.

validation.prechargeControls: Long strings, accumulated exact quotas, one-below rejection without changing work, zero-pass and overflowing pass count. The helper is the one used by export; this is not an end-to-end oversized-LTYPE quota fixture.
validation.logNote: Results observed directly; simultaneous CTest runs can overwrite LastTest.log.

independentPeer.result: Locally authored source and actual ASCII/binary outputs have selected tuples, dictionary and provider relationships, ENTITIES/BLOCKS consumer identities, ownership and modeled geometry as projected. Independent ordinary read and auditor report zero errors and fixes for source and both outputs. No native or renderer claim.
